headers.name: Strict-Transport-Security
headers.description: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) is not set, which could allow SSL stripping attacks.
headers.remediation: Configure your web server to include the Strict-Transport-Security header with a max-age of at least 31536000 seconds (1 year).

headers.name: X-Frame-Options
headers.description: X-Frame-Options header is missing, which could allow clickjacking attacks.
headers.remediation: Configure your web server to include the X-Frame-Options header with value DENY or SAMEORIGIN.

headers.name: X-Content-Type-Options
headers.description: X-Content-Type-Options header is missing, which could lead to MIME type sniffing attacks.
headers.remediation: Configure your web server to include the X-Content-Type-Options header with value nosniff.

headers.name: Content-Security-Policy
headers.description: Content-Security-Policy header is missing, which could allow cross-site scripting (XSS) and other code injection attacks.
headers.remediation: Implement a Content Security Policy to restrict the sources of content that can be loaded on your web pages.

headers.name: Server
headers.description: Server header reveals potentially sensitive information about the web server technology and version.
headers.remediation: Configure your web server to remove or obfuscate the Server header.

ports.title: SMB Exposure
ports.description: SMB (Server Message Block) service is exposed, which is often targeted by ransomware and lateral movement attacks.
ports.remediation: Block SMB (port 445) from untrusted networks and ensure SMBv1 is disabled. Use a firewall to restrict access to trusted networks only.

ports.title: RDP Exposure
ports.description: Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) is exposed, which is a common target for brute-force attacks and ransomware.
ports.remediation: Use Network Level Authentication (NLA), restrict RDP access via VPN or firewall, and consider using a jump host or zero-trust network access.

ports.title: RPC Exposure
ports.description: Microsoft RPC endpoint mapper is exposed, which can be used for reconnaissance and exploitation.
ports.remediation: Block port 135 from untrusted networks and restrict RPC services to internal networks only.

ports.title: NetBIOS Exposure
ports.description: NetBIOS session service is exposed, which can leak sensitive information and facilitate SMB attacks.
ports.remediation: Disable NetBIOS or restrict access to trusted networks. Consider disabling SMBv1 and using SMBv2 or higher with encryption.

ssl_errors.title: SSL Certificate Expired
ssl_errors.description: SSL certificate has expired and is no longer valid.

ssl_errors.title: Self-Signed SSL Certificate
ssl_errors.description: The SSL certificate is self-signed, which is not trusted by browsers.
ssl_errors.remediation: Replace the self-signed certificate with one from a trusted Certificate Authority.

ssl_errors.title: SSL Hostname Mismatch
ssl_errors.description: SSL certificate hostname does not match the server hostname.
ssl_errors.remediation: Ensure the SSL certificate matches the domain name being used or update the certificate to include the correct hostnames.

ssl_errors.title: Weak SSL Cipher Suite
ssl_errors.description: SSL/TLS configuration uses weak ciphers that are considered weak.
ssl_errors.remediation: Configure the server to use only strong cipher suites and disable weak ones.

ssl_errors.title: Untrusted SSL Issuer
ssl_errors.description: SSL certificate is issued by an unknown or untrusted Certificate Authority.
ssl_errors.remediation: Install the proper intermediate certificates or use a certificate from a trusted CA.
